responsibility: Public declaration header for the `brig_to_generic` translation driver and related frontend-wide helper APIs. It defines the global translation state for BRIG module parsing, symbol tables, section accessors, private/group segment bookkeeping, finished-function tracking, kernel list management, mangling helpers, and utility entry points such as builtin-call construction and tree reinterpretation that are shared across the BRIG frontend.
same_name_distinction: Declares the brig_to_generic driver, its module-wide state, and shared frontend helper APIs/templates; the companion brig-to-generic.cc supplies the actual translation pipeline and helper definitions.
